NATIONAL HERITAGE ACT 2005

NATIONAL HERITAGE (DECLARATION OF NATIONAL HERITAGE)

(HERITAGE SITE) ORDER 2011

IN exercise of the powers conferred by subsection 67(1) of the National Heritage

Act 2005 [Act 645], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation

1. This order may be cited as the National Heritage (Declaration of National

Heritage) (Heritage Site) Order 2011.

National Heritage

2. The sites described in columns (1), (2) and (3) of the Schedule that have been

declared as heritage site as published in the Gazette described in column (4) and listed

in the Register are declared to be National Heritage.
